limitations: Wire decoder, checked-frame binding and parser-report admission are abstract trusted adapters; concrete strict HTTP decoding, identity remapping and bounded isolated Alloy worker correspondence require finite and integration tests.
No proof of actual Alloy parser/printer, source-span correspondence, Java or TypeScript refinement, SQL atomicity or browser behavior.
State transitions are serialized abstract steps, not database linearizability; workspace aggregate quota, reservations, admission fencing and CAS execution require tests.

Experimental infer is proven sound and complete only for signature and variable references; other results are not a complete formal typing oracle. Finite 23-tag fixtures carry separate Typed judgments.
Occurrence paths are checked for existence and source binding, not proven to denote the parser-reported source construct; UUID-to-forest correspondence is trusted/tested.
Single-document admission bounds are an abstraction; revision zero is retained and receipts persist across all modeled steps, with no wall-clock or deletion model.
Receipt digest computation, parser/source elaboration, exact response bytes and command translation are concrete adapter obligations; replay authority uses exact method, route and body bytes.

Unknown applied success and unknown applied denial are separate abstract constructors; the runtime maps both to UNKNOWN_COMMIT_OUTCOME. Absence of commit/denial after unknown requires database recovery, not inferred rollback.
